Symbolic small-dimensional calculations corroborate, but the proof holds for every m.

The prior same-paper correction and relevant operator-pair literature were compared by implication, and neither proves the reverse extremal inequalities or critical singular weaving among individual Riesz bases. value.rationale: The square-root source-count scale is a central robustness threshold in multi-source frame weaving. The result supplies exact best universal energy bounds for every radius and m, and shows that at the critical radius each of the m individual systems may remain a Riesz basis while a weave fails. The simultaneous rank-one alignment identifies the mechanism and demonstrates no uniform improvement of the known estimates is possible.
